business_problem: ElasticRun needed a better way to support store-level demand forecasting and supply chain analytics for rural commerce because pipeline slowdowns and brittle infrastructure made it hard to optimize inventory and delivery for millions of underserved stores.
solution_summary: ElasticRun uses Databricks Data + AI Platform to support store-level demand forecasting and supply chain analytics for rural commerce. The implementation replaced a legacy state where pipeline slowdowns and brittle infrastructure made it hard to optimize inventory and delivery for millions of underserved stores. Rural commerce transactions and inventory and logistics data move through Lakeflow Jobs and Spark Declarative Pipelines and land in Delta Lake, giving teams one trusted data foundation. Unity Catalog governs access, lineage, and compliance across sensitive datasets. Databricks SQL, MLflow, and Agent Bricks operationalize models, agents, and analytics that deliver demand forecasts and supply chain decisions.
business_outcome: ElasticRun improved store-level demand forecasting and supply chain analytics for rural commerce with measurable results including 10,000+ machine learning models managed, 90% fewer data pipeline slowdowns from large data volumes, and In cost savings on more than 20 systems, while giving teams a faster path from governed data to production decisions.
metrics: 90% fewer data pipeline slowdowns from large data volumes
In cost savings on more than 20 systems
architecture_clues: Centralized governance, lineage, and access controls are enforced through Unity Catalog.
Delta Lake provides the shared storage layer for curated lakehouse datasets.
Automated ingestion and transformation pipelines keep source data synchronized for downstream analytics and AI.
Operational AI workflows are deployed directly beside governed data and analytics assets.
evidence_quotes: Our existing pipelines and data infrastructure had hit a glass ceiling. We needed a reliable data and AI platform that could meet our current data demands and scale as we continued to grow,
Delta Lake gave us the ability to scale effortlessly, allowing us to focus on driving real-time insights instead of worrying about system failures.
By consolidating 2,500 reports into 50–60 dashboards, we’ve shifted our focus from troubleshooting to innovation,
